summary: Frontend E2E test of Bragr PDF export feature and general write flow. All 7 requested checks PASSED: (1) Landing page shows the new Bragr logo image (/bragr-logo.png) in header, no legacy ECHO string. (2) Both new taglines present: 'Vi genererer ikke ord. Vi finner din stemme.' and 'Bragr — norrønt for «diktekunst» og «den fremste».' (3) Footer contact link has correct mailto:hei@bragrapp.no?subject=Hilsen%20fra%20BRAGR href. (4) Email registration via /logg-inn works — created fresh user pdftest_<ts>@example.com and was redirected to /dashboard. (5) On /skriv, entering a Norwegian prompt and clicking 'Skriv' streamed a real 1426-char Norwegian creative-writing draft from Claude Sonnet 4.5. (6) 'Last ned .txt' (data-testid=write-download-btn) downloaded bragr-utkast-2026-07-27.txt (1461 bytes) with the generated text. (7) 'Last ned .pdf' (data-testid=write-pdf-btn) is visible, enabled after generation, downloaded bragr-utkast-2026-07-27.pdf (2.4 MB, valid PDF magic bytes %PDF-1.3 + %%EOF trailer), and the 'PDF lastet ned' success toast was shown. Backend GET /api/ returns {"app":"BRAGR","ok":true} as required.

issues: PDF file size is ~2.4 MB for a ~1.5 KB draft because the full-resolution 22 KB PNG logo is embedded once as watermark + once as header, and jsPDF stores it uncompressed at high quality. Consider pre-scaling / downsampling the watermark to keep PDFs small; still functional but heavier than expected.

action_items: (Optional) Reduce PDF file size by downsampling the watermark logo (e.g. draw at natural size onto a 400px-wide canvas before addImage) so exports stay well under 1 MB.
critical_code_review_comments: WritePage.jsx downloadPdf() correctly awaits Image().onload before drawing — no race. Uses pt/a4, times font, sensible margins.

Watermark is drawn once on page 1 only (before splitTextToSize / autoPagination). If pdf.text() overflows to multiple pages, subsequent pages will show only the header/footer but NOT the watermark. Consider iterating pages after text is laid out and re-adding the watermark to each. Minor nit — spec said 'watermark' which is ambiguous.
PDF/TXT/Email buttons all correctly guarded by `disabled={streaming || !output}` and re-enable as soon as streaming completes.
Footer.jsx mailto includes subject param — good UX.
Landing.jsx correctly replaced ECHO wordmark with component (verified in DOM: ).
Backend /api/ returns branded {app:'BRAGR', ok:true} — matches spec.
test_credentials: Newly registered email/password user via /api/auth/register: pdftest_<epoch>@example.com / TestPassword123! (any fresh email works since Bragr allows open registration).
seed_data_creation: One test user was registered in Mongo during the run. No cleanup performed (email is timestamped and disposable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export works end-to-end. Downloaded artifacts saved at /tmp/downloads/bragr-utkast-2026-07-27.pdf (2.4MB) and .txt. Backend Claude Sonnet 4.5 generation via /api/generate SSE stream is fully functional in the preview environment — no need to fake output; ~10s to complete a medium Norwegian scene. If retesting, register a fresh timestamped email and directly navigate to /skriv after login (no subscription gate hit).
